jobs.title: NEODIPLOMATI TECNICI DA ADIBIRE AL CONTROLLO QUALITÀ
jobs.description:
Umana S.p.A. cerca NEODIPLOMATI TECNICI DA ADIBIRE AL CONTROLLO QUALITÀ
in zona GALLARATE (VA)
per un’importante azienda del territorio operante nel settore della meccanica, dei macchinari e della lavorazione dei metalli. Ti occuperai di verificare la conformità dei componenti prodotti rispetto alle specifiche tecniche e agli standard aziendali, effettuando controlli dimensionali, visivi e funzionali durante le diverse fasi produttive. Collaborerai con il reparto produzione per individuare eventuali non conformità, contribuendo al miglioramento continuo dei processi e garantendo il rispetto delle procedure qualità e di sicurezza.

Responsabilità che si acquisiranno nel tempo:

Eseguire controlli dimensionali e visivi
sui particolari meccanici utilizzando strumenti di misura quali calibro, durometro, elettroutensili
.
Eseguire prove di durezza.

Eseguire controlli MT

Verificare la conformità dei prodotti finiti e semilavorati rispetto a disegni tecnici, tolleranze, cicli di lavorazione e specifiche di commessa.
Registrare gli esiti dei controlli su apposita documentazione aziendale, compilando report di qualità e schede di non conformità.
Segnalare tempestivamente anomalie, difetti o scostamenti produttivi al responsabile qualità e ai referenti del reparto produzione.
Collaborare alla gestione delle non conformità, supportando l’individuazione delle cause e l’attuazione di azioni correttive.
Garantire il rispetto delle procedure aziendali, delle norme di sicurezza e degli standard qualitativi previsti.

Requisiti:

Diploma di scuola superiore, preferibilmente a indirizzo tecnico o meccanico.

Capacità di lettura e interpretazione del disegno tecnico meccanico.
Conoscenza delle principali tolleranze dimensionali e geometriche.
Buona dimestichezza nell’utilizzo di strumenti di misura meccanici.
Predisposizione al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione con i reparti produttivi.
Disponibilità al lavoro su 2 turni e disponibilità allo straordinario

Si offre contratto iniziale di somministrazione con finalità assuntiva.

Operiamo nel rispetto delle diversità e con impegno nel favorire equità e pari opportunità, praticando e valorizzando l'inclusione. jobs.title: Medical Data Analyst (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Hol' dir den Kick als DocCheck

Medical Data Analyst (m/w/d)

Patient:innendaten verwalten? Für dich fängt die Arbeit da erst an. Du liebst Medizin und willst mit Technik und KI neue Antworten finden, statt den Status quo nur zu bedienen? Als Medical Data Analyst bei DocCheck baust du ein neues Geschäftsfeld in unserer eigenen Marktforschung mit auf. Im Herzen der DocCheck Community hast du direkten Zugang zur Zielgruppe. Du entwickelst aus anonymisierten Patient:innendaten Analysen und Handlungsempfehlungen für die Pharmaindustrie und prägst ein Data-Lake-Projekt von der ersten Idee an. Du hast keine Lust mehr, dich zwischen Medizin und Technik zu entscheiden? Worauf wartest du! DocCheck versetzt den kompletten Gesundheitsmarkt in absolute Effizienz-Ekstase. Egal ob News, Foren, Fachartikel, Medizinshop oder Kreativ-Agentur – DocCheck rührt den Medicals die ultimative Service-Mischung an.

Deine Substanz

Du hast einen Abschluss in Pharmazie, Medizin, Biomedizin, Public Health oder einem vergleichbaren Fach und kennst die medizinische Versorgungsrealität. Du bringst zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung mit Gesundheits- oder Real-World-Daten oder aus der Pharma-Marktforschung mit. ICD-10, ATC-Codes, Wirkstoff vs. Präparat und Therapielinien sind für dich Alltag. Du erkennst unplausible Werte, stellst die richtigen Fragen an Daten und weißt, welche Erkenntnisse für die Pharmaindustrie wirklich zählen. SQL oder Python sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest dich gerne mit KI-Tools in Datenbankabfragen ein. Ein sorgfältiger Umgang mit sensiblen Daten, Datenschutz und Arzneimittelsicherheit ist für dich selbstverständlich.

Dein Trip

Du bist die medizinische Stimme in unserem neuen Real-World-Data-Team. Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Scientists gehst du anonymisierten Versorgungsdaten auf den Grund. Du prüfst sie auf medizinische Plausibilität und legst fest, welche Messwerte, Diagnosen und Therapieinformationen wie strukturiert werden müssen. Medizinische und pharmazeutische Fragestellungen übersetzt du in konkrete Analyseanforderungen und entwickelst Hypothesen, etwa zu Therapieverläufen und Therapiewechseln. Die Ergebnisse interpretierst du und leitest daraus Insights und Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Erste Abfragen und Analysen baust du mit KI-Tools selbst.

jobs.description:
TECHNICIEN DE LABORATOIRE H/F

Chimie des eaux

INOVALYS FilièreEnvironnement site de Tours

Vous souhaitez intégrer un laboratoire public dynamique et engagé, intervenant dans les domaines de la Santé animale, de l’Environnement, et de l’Alimentation au service des populations et des acteursprofessionnels des Paysde la Loire, du CentreVal de Loire et du Morbihan.
Rejoignez Inovalys !

Ses missions de service public vont du contrôle de la qualité de l’eau potable, des eaux de baignades et de l’environnement, au suivi des rejets industriels, au diagnostic et à la prévention des maladies animales ainsi qu’à la surveillance de la qualité chimique et biologique des aliments. Fort de 550 collaborateurs répartis à Angers, Le Mans, Nantes, Tours, Vannes et Lorient, Inovalys est intervenu dans la gestion de nombreuses crises sanitaires ces dernières années. C’est aussi un laboratoire impliqué au travers de ses engagements en matière de Responsabilités Sociales, sociétales et Environnementales des entreprises (RSE).

Description du poste

Notre laboratoire recherche un technicien de laboratoire en chimie, pour la réalisation d’analyses physico-chimiques dans l’eau (eau potable, eaux naturelles et effluents) pour son site de Tours

Missions:

Vous réalisez les analyses sur des échantillons d’eaux, dans le respect du système d‘assurance qualité, sécurité, environnement.
Technique employée : Spectrophotométrie, Séquentiel, Flux, Titration, COT, ICP-MS, potentiométrie, …
Exemple d’analyses réalisées au laboratoire : pH, Conductivité, Turbidité, Chlorures, Ammonium, nitrites, nitrates, COT, NK, DCO, DBO, MES, Phosphore, Phosphates, métaux, …

Conditionset Temps de travail :

39 H - posteà 100%
CDD 12 mois
Poste à pourvoir le 2 janvier 2027

Exigencesparticulières :
De formation BAC+2 filière chimique ou équivalent.
Rigueur, organisation, polyvalence, sens de l’organisation, autonomie, esprit d’équipe.

Posséder de l’expérience et des connaissances en lien avec les analyses de chimie.

Lettre de motivation et CV à envoyer par mail pour le 9 décembre 2026 à 12 h dernier délai à : contact.RH@inovalys.fr

Derby, UK

About The Team

The Inbound Quality Compliance Auditor is responsible for the uninterrupted flow of Goods In and Goods Out of the storage areas within our Warehouse. You will ensure the quality and accuracy of all Goods In items from internal transfers and suppliers and that they are checked thoroughly and accurately. This includes checking Use By dates are correct, Minimum Life On Receipt is compliant, pallets are correctly stacked and labeled and ingredients are quality checked.

You will be working to ensure best practices are followed at all times. Guided by our Raw Material Technologists (RMT’s), you’ll be directed to maintain the highest product standards whilst delivering on business KPIs working within the FSQA team.

Raise and escalate food safety and quality issues following the internal escalation process and ensuring clear and effective communication.
Carry out routine processes such as, but not limited to, temperature monitoring, scale and calibration checks.
Provide support to the wider site FSQA team with food safety and quality issues.
Undertaking basic problem solving activities and escalating to the Quality Lead where necessary. Supporting the RMTs in project work and identifying trends, problems and opportunities for improvement.
Work in both ambient and temperature-controlled environments
Maintain the uninterrupted flow of goods in and out of our storage areas
Ensuring compliance with Standard Operating Procedures and Instructions.
Ensuring that Food Safety and Health & Safety standards are met and sustainably maintained. You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant
jobs.description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.

When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.

ALS Minerals is internationally recognised as the global leader in providing geochemical sample preparation, analytical procedures and data management solutions, with its European hub lab based in Loughrea, Co. Galway.

We are currently seeking motivated individuals to join our team as Speciality Laboratory Assistants Night Shift with an immediate start.

Duties / Responsibilities (non-exhaustive list):

Follow safety rules and practices at all times.
Wear protective equipment specified for each task.
Advise Supervisor if you see anything suspicious or potentially hazardous or if

you see possibilities for improvement.

Perform work as per assignment given by the Laboratory Manager or other

supervisor. Report completion of the work.

Follow written methods and procedures when carrying out work. When written

instructions are not available follow oral instructions given by the Laboratory

Manager or other Supervisor.

Check and maintain order of the samples being processed and samples

identification. Report any deviations to the Laboratory Manager or other

Supervisor.

Handle the samples so as to preserve their identification and prevent their loss, contamination or confusion. Report any accidents to the Laboratory Manager or other Supervisor.
Monitor quality of work being performed, make notes of any anomalies, e.g.

reactive samples, boil overs and incomplete dissolution. Report to the Laboratory Manager or Supervisor if necessary.

Fill in appropriate forms and worksheets and sign/initial records.
Operate equipment according to instructions/manuals and follow safety rules at all times. If applicable (e.g. balances, dispensers, dilutors) check calibration

status of the equipment daily or before use. Report any anomalies/deviations in equipment performance to the Laboratory Manager or Supervisor. Do not use

equipment that is out of order, misbehaving or giving suspicious results.

Perform routine maintenance of the equipment (e.g. lubrication, changing/cleaning parts) as per equipment manuals/instructions. Keep equipment and workplace clean.
When work is finished, tidy up the work area, clean equipment used and get

everything ready for the next use.

Bring considerations regarding possible method or operation improvements to the Laboratory Manager or Quality Manager.
Complete all required records as per ISO 17025, INAB requirements and the

laboratory’s quality management system.

Experience & Expertise:

Generally, none required as full training is provided, however previous laboratory

experience is desirable.

Qualification & Training:

Full or partial secondary education with the ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions.

These roles are primarily Monday to Friday but will require overtime to be carried out on weekends from time to time.

Working at ALS

The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.

Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.

At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.

We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.

Everyone Matters

ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.

ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request. 

Eligibility

To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.

How To Apply

Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

new_jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant
new_jobs.description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.

When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.

ALS Minerals is internationally recognised as the global leader in providing geochemical sample preparation, analytical procedures and data management solutions, with its European hub lab based in Loughrea, Co. Galway.

We are currently seeking motivated individuals to join our team as Speciality Laboratory Assistants Night Shift with an immediate start.

Duties / Responsibilities (non-exhaustive list):

Follow safety rules and practices at all times.
Wear protective equipment specified for each task.
Advise Supervisor if you see anything suspicious or potentially hazardous or if

you see possibilities for improvement.

Perform work as per assignment given by the Laboratory Manager or other

supervisor. Report completion of the work.

Follow written methods and procedures when carrying out work. When written

instructions are not available follow oral instructions given by the Laboratory

Manager or other Supervisor.

Check and maintain order of the samples being processed and samples

identification. Report any deviations to the Laboratory Manager or other

Supervisor.

Handle the samples so as to preserve their identification and prevent their loss, contamination or confusion. Report any accidents to the Laboratory Manager or other Supervisor.
Monitor quality of work being performed, make notes of any anomalies, e.g.

reactive samples, boil overs and incomplete dissolution. Report to the Laboratory Manager or Supervisor if necessary.

Fill in appropriate forms and worksheets and sign/initial records.
Operate equipment according to instructions/manuals and follow safety rules at all times. If applicable (e.g. balances, dispensers, dilutors) check calibration

status of the equipment daily or before use. Report any anomalies/deviations in equipment performance to the Laboratory Manager or Supervisor. Do not use

equipment that is out of order, misbehaving or giving suspicious results.

Perform routine maintenance of the equipment (e.g. lubrication, changing/cleaning parts) as per equipment manuals/instructions. Keep equipment and workplace clean.
When work is finished, tidy up the work area, clean equipment used and get

everything ready for the next use.

Bring considerations regarding possible method or operation improvements to the Laboratory Manager or Quality Manager.
Complete all required records as per ISO 17025, INAB requirements and the

laboratory’s quality management system.

Experience & Expertise:

Generally, none required as full training is provided, however previous laboratory

experience is desirable.

Qualification & Training:

Full or partial secondary education with the ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions.

These roles are primarily Monday to Friday but will require overtime to be carried out on weekends from time to time.

Working at ALS

The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.

Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.

At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.

We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.

Everyone Matters

ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.

ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request. 

Eligibility

To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.

How To Apply

Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.
